name: Xander Rosario
source:
A dedicated police officer trying his best always! Epitome of lawful good. He’ll do anything to make sure that justice is served. He is an ex-military soldier and does have some problems with PTSD. Before this case Xander worked Vice, he’s very street smart and knows how to talk to people well. (Fun Fact: Xander is cuban, he… also has an accent >_>;;;)
